question: In which city is the Arun Jaitley Stadium located?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arun Jaitley Stadium** is located in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• It was previously known as the **Feroz Shah Kotla Stadium** before being renamed in 2019 in honor of the late **Arun Jaitley**, a prominent Indian politician and former finance minister.
 
• The stadium is operated by the **Delhi and District Cricket Association (DDCA)**.
 
• It is one of the oldest cricket grounds in India, established in 1883.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of around **41,820 spectators**.
 
• It has hosted numerous international cricket matches, including **Test matches, One Day Internationals (ODIs), and T20 Internationals**.
 
• The stadium is also the home ground for the **Delhi Capitals** franchise in the Indian Premier League (IPL).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Punjab**__

 __
 
• Punjab is a state in northern India known for its vibrant culture and history.
 
• The capital of Punjab is **Chandigarh**, which is also a Union Territory and serves as the capital of Haryana.
 
• Punjab is famous for its agricultural productivity and is often referred to as the "**Granary of India**" or "**India's Breadbasket**".
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**__
 __
 
• Mumbai is the capital city of the Indian state of **Maharashtra**.
 
• It is the most populous city in India and the seventh most populous city in the world.
 
• Mumbai is the financial, commercial, and entertainment capital of India.
 
• The city is home to the **Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)**, one of the oldest stock exchanges in Asia.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**__
 
 
• Chennai is the capital city of the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is known for its rich cultural heritage and is often referred to as the "**Detroit of India**" due to its automobile industry.
 
• Chennai is also famous for its beaches, temples, and classical music and dance forms.
